svg.text: Three gauges plus dated progress points.
Net worth = Assets − Liabilities. The header uses the same response.
Each save of a finance change writes one dated point.
Show actual progress points against a fixed-date plan.
Actual points snap to the nearest projection

A saved finance change writes exactly one progress point. Editing without saving writes none.
